title: API rate limiting middleware
description: Add edge/middleware rate limiting for API routes to prevent abuse and DoS
completion: Created middleware.ts with edge-level rate limiting for /api/v1/* routes: 120 GET/min and 40 mutation/min per IP. In-memory sliding window with automatic bucket purging and memory exhaustion protection. Exempts /api/v1/health, webhooks, and /api/auth/* (Better Auth handles its own rate limits). Returns 429 with Retry-After and x-ratelimit-* headers. Uses existing RATE_LIMITED error code.
